name: Stash v0.9.117 — Stash wrapped - your listening history + improvements
body:
## Your month, as a story

**Recap.** Home › Your listening now has a Recap: "Your October" as a story you tap through, building up to your #1 song.
- Guess your #1 before it's revealed.
- See your top artists and songs, when you listen ("Night owl: 46% after 10 PM"), your longest streak and the songs you found this month.
- Your music plays behind each card, and whatever you were listening to comes back when you close it.
- Share any card as a picture made for Instagram Stories, or end on the summary poster.
- "Your 2026" arrives on December 1. Earlier months are under Past recaps at the bottom of Your listening.

**Your Last.fm recap.** Connected to Last.fm? Past recaps also has an "On Last.fm" list, with the same story built from your scrobbles. It's kept separate from Stash's own numbers.

**Your listening.** Tap Home › Your listening for your own stats:
- Hours listened, from the last 7 days to all time, with plays, songs, artists and your streak.
- Your top artists, songs, albums and genres. Tap See all for the full lists. Genres come from Last.fm.
- A 24-hour clock of when you listen, your busiest day, what you had On repeat and what's New to you.

**History.** Every song you've played, day by day, with search and a calendar.
- Tap a song and it keeps playing down the list.
- Long-press a song to remove it from history.
- Pause or clear your history in Settings › Library & Storage › Listening history. Your history stays on your phone.

## Choose your download quality

Settings › Audio & Quality › **Download quality**:
- **Lossless (FLAC)**: the best quality, as before.
- **AAC 320**: smaller files, still great sound, from Tidal.
- **Opus**: the smallest files, from YouTube.

Also fixed: a song that plays in AAC from Tidal now downloads in AAC too. With the lossy fallback off, a download no longer quietly turns into a YouTube file; it waits instead.

The daily allowance now counts Tidal AAC as well as lossless, and Settings shows it as "Tidal & Qobuz today".

## A cleaner look

- The **Now playing** button that appears while you scroll a list is now small and see-through.
- Library's tabs, the shuffle button and the Stream only switch take the colour of the song that's playing.
- Library rows show just the coloured dots for Spotify and YouTube. The space goes to the song title and the FLAC badge.
- Smaller Daily Discover and mix cards, and a slightly smaller STASH logo.
- You can now move or hide **Daily Discover** in Settings › Appearance › Home layout. Your listening sits right under it for now; move it wherever you like.
- The Search tab drops its title, so the search box sits at the top.

## Also new since the last release

- **Drag the mini player up** into Now Playing with your finger, and drag down to close it.
- **The play button keeps its colour** as the player opens, and black-and-white covers now give a soft grey instead of purple.
- **New tab bar:** only the tab you're on shows its name, with new icons.
- Fixed: Now Playing's song menu could act on the next song if the song changed while it was open.
- **Support Stash:** Settings › Donate now also offers PayPal for rawn, next to Ko-fi.

Older listens didn't record how long you actually listened, so their time is worked out from the song's length. That's why some times say "about".
